name: How long does a hidden leak detection service typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a hidden leak detection service typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a hidden leak detection service can vary depending on the complexity and location of the leak. A straightforward slab leak might be found within an hour, while more elusive or multiple leaks in an older, extensive plumbing system could take several hours. Factors like the size of your property, the type of plumbing, and the accessibility of the affected area influence the timeline. Our team in Las Vegas aims for efficient detection to provide a timely assessment and repair plan, typically completing most detections within 1-3 hours.
acceptedAnswer.description: Leak detection time varies, usually 1-3 hours, depending on leak complexity, property size, and plumbing system accessibility.
